note: The script checks in a tree that builds the core only (register decision 246). The script mutants remove the core-only rule either way and are judged by parallel_tests_self_test, since the tree that runs a pass builds the application; the CMake mutants tell a tree that builds the application that it builds none, and register the mutants_due checks only where it is not built, and are judged by the real tests. The opposite mutant -- the mutants_due checks registered in every tree -- changes nothing in a tree that builds the application, so it is judged instead by the core-only Linux trees' own runs. Python and a regenerated Ninja file need no build, but the harness always builds, so every mutant names orbsim_shaders as a no-op.
